query:
The group has a norm of a monthly minimum check-in in the chat. Does everyone follow it?

Options:
A. Abi
B. Dev
C. Kwame
D. Sasha
context:
[1] (about=Kwame, episodic, t6 @2025-06-23T21:14:00) Also, quick admin. Dev, you've been MIA for like six weeks. The whole point of this chat is monthly minimum. I know you're in the archive. Send a voice note, a meme, anything.
[2] (about=Dev, episodic, t6 @2025-06-23T23:58:00) sorry, I know, I know. head down in the archive. I'm trying to come for the Saturday. I genuinely want to be there. when the PhD is done this all gets easier, I promise 💙
[3] (about=Dev, episodic, t2 @2025-06-09T23:22:00) sorry, only just seeing this, head down in the archive. November I genuinely want to come. When the PhD is done things will be different. I promise I'll try to make November work
[4] (about=Dev, episodic, t0 @2025-06-02T16:17:00) sorry, head down in the archive all morning 🙈 Amsterdam sounds incredible and I genuinely want to come. October is tricky but I don't want to say no yet. can we talk dates?
[5] (about=Kwame, episodic, t8 @2025-06-30T14:59:00) yes. Sasha's format from now on. Dev, you missed a good one. I'll tell you about it when we speak. You were there in spirit.
[6] (about=Kwame, episodic, t2 @2025-06-09T20:04:00) I can host in London. Sasha's idea is the right one. We've been trying to book hotels and trips for two years. Let's just be in the same room. Dev, you have to actually come.
[7] (about=Kwame, episodic, t4 @2025-06-16T18:37:00) First Saturday of next month. I'll be at mine. Dev, I'm coming to Edinburgh next week actually. Separate thing. He's heads-down at the moment but I wanted to see him.
[8] (about=Dev, episodic, t4 @2025-06-16T18:46:00) Edinburgh next week works if you're serious Kwame. coffee and a walk maybe
[9] (about=Abi, episodic, t6 @2025-06-24T00:02:00) yes literally a blurry archive corridor pic would sustain us for a month 😂
[10] (about=Sasha, episodic, t6 @2025-06-24T00:01:00) no guilt spiral pls, just send us something chaotic once in a while and we're happy 😊
[11] (about=Sasha, episodic, t8 @2025-06-30T14:54:00) that was perfect. THAT is my idea of a good time. home, food, no pretension, just us. can we do this every couple of months?
